name: Shuten Douji
description: (Tag:fighter)(Tag:fire)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:linked)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:poison)(Tag:spirit)(Character)The Oni ruler of Mount Ooe and daughter of Yamato No Orochi, a minor demi-god with unrivalled strength, endurance, and mana-expelled flame. She intoxicates and charms through presence or breath, and her Noble Phantasm unleashes potent gourd poison and stores targets inside; she can also debone people bloodlessly. As a Heroic Spirit her strength depends on her master's mana.
